name: particles
title: Particles
description: An ambient `<canvas>` particle field for hero and section backdrops: `quantity` dots (100 by default) drifting on their own velocities, fading in near the middle and out near the edges, respawned whenever one leaves the box.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/particles

Installed to `components/ui/magicui/particles.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/magicui/particles';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/particles

Requires the `@interlace/theme` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency).
